programmer.name: Programmer
programmer.subtitle: Programmer
programmer.summary: I am an electronics technician, currently studying Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence. I am comfortable in work that calls for independence and problem solving. I am looking for a chance to learn new tools of the trade, technical or human, and to put what I already know to active use.

blocks.heading: Problem solving
blocks.text: I can find the solution to problems on my own and I work focused on moving towards the result. I handle stress well and can hurry without losing my calm. I rarely go blank.

blocks.heading: Drive
blocks.text: I usually work at a lively pace, without getting frustrated by difficulty and without losing track of what I have to do. I am not shy about raising a problem or asking for help. I am even-tempered, neither touchy nor offensive.

blocks.heading: Technical communication
blocks.text: I speak literally and specifically. I can explain or report a situation without ambiguity. I take instructions exactly as they are written. Reading technical documentation is part of my everyday work.

ai-teacher.name: AI teacher
ai-teacher.subtitle: Artificial Intelligence teacher
ai-teacher.summary: I have been tutoring secondary school and university students since 2018, and I work as a software developer at Obrok. I am an advanced student of the University Technical Degree in Artificial Intelligence at UNR. I want to teach how to use artificial intelligence in concrete work tasks: what each tool does, when it is worth using and how to check what it produces.

blocks.heading: Clear communication
blocks.text: I explain technical concepts precisely and without needless jargon. Years of private tutoring taught me to rephrase an idea until it gets across.

blocks.heading: Practical approach
blocks.text: I teach with concrete examples and exercises, so that what is learned can be put to use at work right away.

blocks.heading: Patience
blocks.text: I answer questions without rushing anyone or losing the pace of the class.
